question: State the area and climate described for Aruba; name the countries bordering Andorra.
raw:
O1: [S2] Aruba has an area of 179 square kilometres (69.1 sq mi), and measures 32 kilometres (20 mi) in length from its north-western to its south-eastern end and is 10 kilometres (6 mi) across at its widest point.
